title: About Micah Hoang — Brand Designer
description: Meet Micah Hoang, a Los Angeles brand designer working across strategy, visual identity, motion, product, packaging, editorial, and UX/UI.

colors.text: I’m a brand designer with a systems mind. I treat design as problem-solving: start with what the brand needs to do, then build the whole system that gets it there.
“He went above and beyond his role, approaching problems with creativity and curiosity, and contributing massively to create high quality work.”
NADIA SHIREEN HUSAIN, ASSOCIATE CREATIVE DIRECTOR, APPLE
